best_transferable_idea: One ordered stacking test (refuse, overwrite or coexist), a per-target resist percent, a six-second tic clock, and mez broken by the first non-lethal hit.
rule: Stacking: resurrection effects stack; complete-heal blockers refuse; same spell refused at lower caster level, else overwrite; AlwaysStackSpells stack; bard song and beneficial stack; when effects differ, stacker ladder 446-449, overwrite command 149 and block command 148 apply (detrimental spells bypass block); per-slot arbitration with exclusions; detrimental DoTs of different spells stack. Duration: formula table gives tics; PvP detrimental uses its own formula; tic is 6 s. Stun: shorter never replaces longer; resist percent roll (lands when roll >= resist). Fear: flee point when pathing on, else stun for remaining tics; PC cap 4 tics. Mez: broken by any non-lethal hit with an attacker. Root: break chance 55 minus bonus, banded by level gap (x0.8 at gap 2, x0.6 at 3-20, x0.2 at 22+; gap 21 falls through). Bash stun: roll 0-100 inclusive, stun when roll > 55 minus bonus, 2000 ms. Gravity: |value|/100 per tick toward or away, none within 5 units.
keep: Ordered stacking test: refuse, overwrite or coexist, decided by one list of checks
Mez breaks on the first non-lethal hit with an attacker
Fear as steps of a fixed tic with a player cap
Root breaks by damage, chance banded by level gap
Shorter stun never replaces a longer one
change: Fewer statuses: stun, fear, mez, root, gravity only; no bard songs
Stacker ladder and block command become one blocks-list field per status kind
Knockdown becomes a server event with a duration (donor knockdown is client-only)
Root band gap 21 joins the 80 percent band (defect 1)
Remove the redundant above-98 bash clause (defect 3)
Resurrection-block slot: first free, not last (defect 4)

At 375 wide judge: stun reads as frozen pose with one timer ring; mez wakes on first hit with one flash; root shakes per hit with its odds as a ring; fear reads as six-second steps. Compare stun and mez with the current build.
